data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: vegetables
sections.question: vegetables
sections.summary: plants or parts of plants that are eaten as food

senses.definition: plants or parts of plants, such as carrots, potatoes, or onions, that are eaten as food
examples: She cooked fresh vegetables for dinner and served them with rice.
Eating vegetables every day is very good for your health.

answers.answer: She cooked fresh vegetables for dinner and served them with rice.
He drank a hot cup of vegetables every morning before school.
She poured the vegetables into her glass and added some ice.
They spread vegetables on their toast instead of butter and jam.

sections.title: water
sections.question: water
sections.summary: the clear liquid that falls as rain and is essential for all living things

senses.definition: a clear, colourless liquid with no smell or taste that falls as rain and is essential for all living things
examples: She drank a glass of water because she was very thirsty.
He drinks eight glasses of water every day to stay healthy.

senses.definition: to pour water onto plants to help them grow
examples: She waters the plants in her garden every morning.
He forgot to water the flowers and they died.

answers.answer: She drank a glass of water because she was very thirsty after her run.
He ate a large plate of cold water for his lunch.
She spread water on her toast every morning instead of butter.
He grew water in his garden to use for cooking dinner.
